annotations.title: 2026 FHA multifamily limits, ratios, MIP and fees

description: HUD's 2026 FHA multifamily rulebook as the site publishes it: per-unit statutory limits by bedroom (Section 207/223(f)/220, 221(d)(4) or 231; elevator and non-elevator) with the high-cost amount for a state, loan-to-value and coverage ratios by tier, large-loan ratios, MIP, HUD fees and loan terms, each with its source.

section.description: Limits table: 207_223f_220 (Section 207, 207 pursuant to 223(f), and 220), 221d4, or 231. Default 207_223f_220.

state.description: Optional two-letter state code, to apply its high-cost percentage (405% in AK, HI, GU, VI; 270% elsewhere).
